python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,json,pathlib,time
start=time.monotonic()
try:
 r=subprocess.run(['node','.local/smart-shorts-performance/wasm-probe.mjs','after'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
 pathlib.Path('.local/smart-shorts-performance/wasm-after.log').write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr);print(r.stdout[-1500:]);print('exit',r.returncode)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
 pathlib.Path('.local/smart-shorts-performance/wasm-after.log').write_bytes((e.stdout or b'')+(e.stderr or b''));pathlib.Path('.local/smart-shorts-performance/wasm-after.json').write_text(json.dumps({'completed':False,'timeoutSeconds':90}));print('bounded probe timeout',time.monotonic()-start)
PY
